name: Texas Precision Performance
old_description: Professionally Built Custom 3rd Member Center Sections for Steet Cars, Racing & Off Road Applications
about:
Texas Precision Performance operates from Coleman, Texas, as a veteran- and family-owned business founded by racers with deep drivetrain experience. The company emphasizes its 25-plus years in the industry, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The shop specializes in professionally built custom third-member center sections for Ford 9-inch and GM 8.5/8.6 differentials, covering street, strip, and full-race applications. It also stocks a range of differential parts including Ford 9-inch rear-end gears, Chevy 12-bolt components, and 55-64 Chevy rear-end parts, while carrying brands such as Eaton, Motive Gear, Yukon Gear & Axle, and Strange Engineering. The business runs an online parts storefront alongside its custom assembly work.

Primary markets are racing, off-road, and street-car enthusiasts who need durable drivetrain components for high-performance builds, rebuilds, or replacement parts.

The company states it refuses to sell inferior parts despite competitive pricing, positioning its combination of racer insight and veteran discipline as a differentiator for customers seeking reliable custom assemblies.
